title: Urgent Care in Cabo San Lucas | English-Speaking 24/7
description: Need urgent care in Cabo San Lucas? An English-speaking doctor at your hotel 24/7 for $189 USD or at our downtown clinic for $99, plus pharmacy delivery.
h1: Urgent care in Cabo San Lucas: an English-speaking doctor, 24/7
image_alt: English-speaking doctor providing urgent care to a traveler at a hotel in Cabo San Lucas
whatsapp: Hi! I need urgent care in Cabo. My symptoms are:
intro: At home you might drive to an urgent care center when you have a fever, a bad stomach bug or an infection that cannot wait for your regular doctor. On vacation in Cabo San Lucas the need is the same — but you do not know the area, you may not speak Spanish, and the last thing you want is to spend your trip in a waiting room.
This page explains how urgent care works in Los Cabos, what we can treat at your hotel or at our downtown clinic, what it costs in US dollars, and when you should skip us and call 911 instead.

sections.h2: Your urgent care options in Cabo
p: For problems that are not life-threatening but need a doctor today, you have three practical choices:
list: A doctor at your hotel, villa or yacht — $189 USD, available 24/7. Typical arrival is 30–45 minutes in Cabo San Lucas and the Tourist Corridor, up to about 60 minutes in San José del Cabo, Pedregal and Palmilla.
Our downtown clinic — $99 USD on Francisco I. Madero in Centro, Cabo San Lucas, if you feel well enough to come in.
A hospital emergency room — for true emergencies only (see below).
p_after: Compare all three on our doctor in Cabo San Lucas page.

sections.h2: What we treat as urgent care
p: Our English-speaking doctors see travelers every day for common, non-emergency problems such as:
list: Fever, flu-like symptoms, cough and sore throat
Mild allergic reactions, skin rashes and insect bites
Medication refills when you ran out or forgot your pills at home
p_after: Not sure if your problem fits? Send your symptoms on WhatsApp and we will tell you honestly.

sections.h2: When it is an emergency: call 911
p: Do not wait for a house call if you or someone with you has any of these:
list: Chest pain or pressure, or trouble breathing
Signs of a stroke: face drooping, arm weakness, slurred speech
Severe bleeding, a serious injury or a suspected broken bone
A severe allergic reaction with swelling of the lips, tongue or throat
p_after: In Mexico the emergency number is 911, the same as at home.

sections.h2: What urgent care costs in Cabo
p: Our prices are published in US dollars so there are no surprises: $189 USD for a doctor at your hotel, villa or yacht and $99 USD at our downtown clinic. Medicines are extra and can be delivered to you. If you feel dehydrated, an IV drip starts at $159 at your door. See every price on our price list.

In Mexico, antibiotics need a prescription from a doctor licensed in Mexico. After the consultation our doctor can write it on the spot, and our pharmacy in Cabo San Lucas delivers the medicine to your room — free on orders over $50 USD.

We accept international health and travel insurance from the United States and Canada, subject to policy verification and coverage confirmation. If coverage cannot be confirmed, you pay at the visit and receive an itemized invoice in English and US dollars. Check your policy before your trip so you know what it covers.

sections.h2: How to get urgent care now
list: Message us on WhatsApp or call +52 624 226 1023, 24/7, in English or Spanish.
Tell us your symptoms and where you are staying.
We confirm the price and the arrival time, and a doctor comes to you — or you come to our clinic.
p_after: Planning ahead? You can also book a doctor online for a specific time.

faq.q: Is there urgent care in Cabo San Lucas?
faq.a: Yes. For non-emergency problems you can see an English-speaking doctor at your hotel, villa or yacht 24/7 for $189 USD, or at our downtown clinic for $99 USD. For emergencies, call 911.

faq.q: How much does urgent care cost in Cabo?
faq.a: With us, $189 USD for a doctor at your hotel and $99 USD at our clinic. Medicines are extra and pharmacy delivery is free on orders over $50 USD.

faq.q: Do urgent care doctors in Cabo speak English?
faq.a: Ours do. Every consultation can be done in English or Spanish, and you can meet our doctors on our doctor page.

faq.q: Is urgent care open 24 hours in Cabo?
faq.a: Our house-call doctors are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week across Cabo San Lucas, the Tourist Corridor and San José del Cabo.

faq.q: Will my US health insurance cover urgent care in Mexico?
faq.a: Many US plans do not cover care abroad, while travel insurance often does. We accept international health and travel insurance from the United States and Canada, subject to policy verification and coverage confirmation. If you pay yourself, we give you an itemized invoice in English and US dollars.
